title: Fear and hope
hook: the believer flies with two wings, fear and hope

segments.voice: Yesterday, mahabbah, love of Allah, and your line: love follows. Today, love gets two wings.

A bird with one wing doesn't fly. It goes in circles on the ground. Ibn al-Qayyim, a later scholar who wrote about the stations of the path, used a bird to picture the heart on its way to Allah. Love, yesterday's station, is the head. And the two wings are fear and hope. Readers draw out the lesson: lose the wing of fear, and the bird tips into carelessness. Lose the wing of hope, and it tips into despair. Either way, it doesn't get off the ground.
screen: `ONE WING GOES IN CIRCLES.` → `LOVE IS THE HEAD.` → `FEAR AND HOPE ARE THE WINGS.`

segments.voice: In Arabic the pair is khawf and raja, fear and hope, and the Qur'an puts them side by side. Describing the believers at night, it says, in Pickthall's translation, that they "forsake their beds to cry unto their Lord in fear and hope." Not fear, then hope. Both, in the same prayer. Fear here isn't panic. It's taking seriously that your choices matter and a reckoning is real, the evening ledger from a few days ago. It keeps a person honest. Hope is trusting that Allah's mercy is bigger than your mistakes. In Pickthall's words: "Despair not of the mercy of Allah, Who forgiveth all sins." Hope keeps a person from giving up. Now the scene that holds both. In the collection of al-Tirmidhi, the Prophet ﷺ visits a young man who is dying, and asks how he finds himself. The young man answers: I hope in Allah, and I fear my sins. The Prophet says that whenever these two come together in a servant's heart at a moment like that, Allah gives him what he hopes for and keeps him safe from what he fears. He didn't tell the young man to drop either one. He blessed the pair. So the question isn't fear or hope. It's whether both wings are still moving. And if hope ever feels gone, the dark kind that won't lift, please reach out: in the US, call or text 988, any hour; elsewhere, local emergency help.
screen: `KHAWF AND RAJA, SIDE BY SIDE.` · `FEAR KEEPS YOU HONEST.` · `HOPE KEEPS YOU GOING.` · `A YOUNG MAN, HOLDING BOTH.`

segments.voice: Bring up one thing you're worried about in yourself, a habit, a temper, something you keep putting off, and let it be the wing of fear: honest, not frantic. Then find the other wing, one real reason for hope about that same thing, a time you did better, someone who forgave you, and breathe as if both wings were moving together. If you pray, rest on the line: despair not of the mercy of Allah.
Fear and hope. Khawf and raja: taking your choices seriously, and trusting that mercy is bigger than your mistakes, held together like two wings. Today's word.
Your line: two wings. Neither one can fly alone; the bird needs both of them. Until tomorrow.

howItsDone: Muslim teachers describe fear of Allah and hope in His mercy as two things a believer holds together, and some families at a deathbed speak of Allah's mercy so that hope is strong at the end.

guess: khawf and raja: taking sin seriously while trusting mercy
being afraid of Allah instead of ever hoping in Him
hoping for good luck while dreading the bad luck ahead

fork.setup: the Prophet ﷺ visits a young man who is dying and asks how he finds himself. what does the young man say?
options: I'm afraid of my sins, and nothing else.
I hope in Allah, and I fear my sins.
fork.reveal: he holds both. the Prophet says that when the two meet in a heart at such a moment, Allah gives what it hopes and keeps it safe from what it fears.

trapdoor: what you thought: religion is either about fear or about comfort.
what it means: two wings, beating together. fear keeps you honest, hope keeps you going.
what a scholar hears: 32:16, 'in fear and hope', the dying young man in al-Tirmidhi, and Ibn al-Qayyim's bird with love for its head.

chat.says: Shouldn't a believer just focus on hope and forget about fear?
options: Both: the Qur'an pairs fear and hope, and the Prophet blessed a heart holding the two.
Forget hope instead: fear alone keeps you safe, and hope only makes you careless.
Pick one for life: some people are fear people, and some are hope people.
